subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff / trial plan for Finlytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next step: evaluation kickoff

Hi Alex —

Great to meet you yesterday — thanks for walking us through Finlytics' current pipelines and the key latency/cost pain points for your summarization and search workflows. Quick recap from our side: 

- Primary goals: reduce per-query latency for long-form summarization (avg 1,200 tokens) and cut embedding costs for nightly index jobs.
- Success criteria you mentioned: median latency < 400ms on reads, embedding cost reduction >= 30%, and no regressions on factuality for the top-10 queries.
- Constraints: data residency in US regions, SOC 2 evidence required, pilot budget for a 30-day evaluation.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff where we can align the trial plan, confirm success criteria, and review the prompt set/evals you'll provide. Connor (cc'd) will run the technical deep dive and outline the test harness and metrics collection.

Can you share 2–3 windows next week that work for your team? We typically run the kickoff as: 10 min intro, 15 min trial plan & success criteria, 20 min prompt set / evals review, 15 min technical Q&A and next steps.

I'll attach a template for a prompt set and a success-criteria doc to make it easy to fill in.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Finlytics_prompt_set_v1.xlsx (xlsx), Finlytics_success_criteria.docx (docx)

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@finlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next step: evaluation kickoff

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. Sofia and I discussed and we're aligned on the goals you listed. We can do next week — our availability:

- Wed 24 Mar, 11:00–12:30 PT
- Thu 25 Mar, 09:30–10:30 PT
- Fri 26 Mar, 14:00–15:00 PT

We prefer the Wed slot if that works for your team. I'll attach an initial prompt list and the top-of-funnel scenarios we want validated. Also: we need the pilot to include an embedded index run (batch) to measure cost improvements.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Product | Finlytics
alex.jones@finlytics.com

Attachment: finlytics_initial_prompts.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@finlytics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next step: evaluation kickoff

Perfect — Wed 24 Mar, 11:00 PT works for us.

Connor — can you lead the tech agenda? Proposed 60-min agenda below; please edit if you want to change the timings.

Agenda (60 min):
- 0–10 min: Intros + success criteria alignment (Marissa)
- 10–30 min: Trial plan & metrics (what we’ll run, data ingress, regional requirements) (Connor)
- 30–45 min: Prompt set & eval approach (review your sample prompts; identify core prompt groups) (All)
- 45–60 min: Technical Q&A & next steps (deployment options, RBAC, SOC2 evidence and timeline) (Connor + Rishi)

Alex/Sofia — can you share the prompt file and any sample inputs you want us to run ahead of the kickoff? If possible, send a short list of 10 high-priority prompts and a representative batch for the embedding job. That will let Connor pre-configure a run and we can include a quick smoke test in the kickoff.

Connor, Rishi — looping you in on the doc links and the HubSpot deal. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DL-2026-0987
Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/finlytics-eval-plan

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: Finlytics_prompt_set_v1.xlsx

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff — tech agenda and pre-reqs

Thanks team — quick tech notes ahead of the 11:00 PT kickoff: 

1) Pre-reqs we need from Finlytics before the call:
   - Sample payloads for 10 priority prompts (JSONL or XLSX) — please include expected tokens where possible.
   - A small sample of the embedding job input (batch of ~500 rows) and typical batch frequency.
   - Any IP/data handling constraints (PII redaction rules) so we validate preprocess pipelines.

2) What we'll prepare:
   - A 30-day trial plan with specific runs for both generation and embeddings, plus the metrics dashboard we'll populate (latency distributions, cost-per-embedding).
   - A short smoke test Notebook (colab) to run the 10 prompts live during the kickoff.
   - SOC2 evidence checklist and timeline (Rishi will review during the call).

3) Technical assumptions to validate during the call:
   - Region: US-WEST preferred — confirm VPC or hosted options.
   - Target median latency < 400ms for reads (we'll propose model variants + quantization config).

If Alex/Sofia can upload the sample files to the Drive link before 9:00 PT that’ll give us time to pre-configure everything. Looking forward to the session.

—Connor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com

Attachment: kickoff_pre-reqs.txt

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@finlytics.com>

Confirmed — Wed 24 Mar 11:00 PT is ideal but we realized we meant Wed 24 Mar in our timezone (we're on PT as well) — sorry for the confusion. We're ready to go. We've uploaded: Finlytics_prompt_set_v1.xlsx (10 priority prompts + token estimates) and a 500-row sample for the embedding job to the Drive link. Also attaching a brief success criteria doc.

Quick notes:
- We're OK with US-WEST region.
- SOC2 evidence: we'll need a timeline for completion; happy for Rishi to call this out in the kickoff.
- For the embedding batch, please include cost-per-1000 estimates in the trial report.

See you all at 11:00 PT.

Best,
Alex
